description: Call ONLY when the user asks to send feedback to MetricDuck. Pass the user's words in message; set source=user when the user wrote it, model when you summarised it. Sends the text to the MetricDuck team.

category.description: missing_data (a company, period or figure MetricDuck lacks), wrong_value (a figure looks wrong), missing_capability (something MetricDuck cannot do), or other.

message.description: The feedback, in the user's words where possible. At most 1000 characters.

source.description: user = the user wrote the message; model = you summarised what the user said.

name: send_feedback
title: Send Feedback
